# Retrieve cached results for flights, hotels, and attractions
departure_flights = get_results_from_cache(key="departure_flights")
return_flights = get_results_from_cache(key="return_flights")
hotels = get_results_from_cache(key="hotels")
attractions = get_results_from_cache(key="attractions")

# Filter departure flights for first class
filtered_departure_flights = filter_flights(
    prior_results=departure_flights,
    flight_class=["first"]
)

# Filter return flights for first class
filtered_return_flights = filter_flights(
    prior_results=return_flights,
    flight_class=["first"]
)

# Save filtered flight results to cache
save_to_cache(key="filtered_departure_flights", value=filtered_departure_flights)
save_to_cache(key="filtered_return_flights", value=filtered_return_flights)

# Search for attractions near Fountains of Bellagio
attractions_search = search_attractions(
    city="Las Vegas",
    attraction_name=["Fountains of Bellagio"]
)

# Save attraction search results to cache
save_to_cache(key="attractions", value=attractions_search)

# Find nearest hotels to the attractions
nearest_hotels = search_nearest(
    hotels=hotels,
    attractions=attractions_search,
    groupBy="hotel"
)

# Save nearest hotels result to cache
save_to_cache(key="nearest_hotels", value=nearest_hotels)
